normalization: Temporary fixture roots and toolchain paths replaced by placeholders; blank-line trailing spaces removed. Report structure and exception types preserved.
phase_evidence: Captured pytest logs predate the phase probe and now fail closed. tests/test_runner_phases.py runs the real Python runners with the probe, including body, fixture, lifecycle and cleanup assertions.
node_nested: Captured with the Node command above from NESTED in tests/test_node_runner.py; two t.test levels plus a describe suite. Parent tests count toward # fail; suite containers do not.

cases.assertion: One test compares 1 with 2 using Python assert or node:assert/strict.equal.
cases.runtime: One test raises RuntimeError or Error before any assertion.
cases.import: Module imports a nonexistent_regression_dependency before any test runs.
cases.collection: Test module contains invalid syntax before any test runs.
cases.setup: setup_function or test.before raises RuntimeError or Error before the assertion.
cases.mixed: One test raises RuntimeError or Error, another fails its equality assertion.
